title.en: Houthis Target Riyadh as Battles Escalate with Saudi-Backed Forces in Yemen
title.zh-TW: 胡塞武裝（Houthis）瞄準利雅德（Riyadh） 與沙烏地阿拉伯（Saudi Arabia）支持部隊在葉門（Yemen）戰事升溫

summary.en: Houthis launched a ballistic missile toward Riyadh, which Saudi Arabia reported shooting down, while also engaging in fierce battles with Saudi-backed forces in Yemen to expand territory amid rising tensions.
summary.zh-TW: 胡塞武裝（Houthis）向利雅德（Riyadh）發射彈道飛彈，沙烏地阿拉伯（Saudi Arabia）宣稱擊落，同時在葉門（Yemen）與沙烏地阿拉伯支持部隊激戰，企圖擴張領土。

body.en: Lede: Iranian-backed Houthis attempted a ballistic missile strike on Saudi Arabia's capital Riyadh while fighting Saudi-backed government forces in Yemen. What happened: BBC World and NPR World reported that Saudi Arabia stated the Houthis tried to attack Riyadh with a ballistic missile, the first such targeting of the capital since escalation. A reported strike on a fuel depot at Riyadh airport caused delays. NYT World noted the Houthis were engaged in fierce battles with Saudi-backed forces in Yemen on Sunday as they seek to maintain momentum. Why it matters: The incidents highlight ongoing escalation between the Iran-backed militia and Saudi Arabia, with Houthis pushing territorial expansion in Yemen. Sources agree/disagree: All sources align on the missile attempt toward Riyadh and the Yemen battles involving Saudi-backed forces. Still uncertain: Exact outcomes of the Yemen ground battles and any confirmed damage from the missile remain unspecified beyond Saudi claims of interception.
body.zh-TW: 導言：伊朗支持的胡塞武裝（Houthis）試圖以彈道飛彈襲擊沙烏地阿拉伯（Saudi Arabia）首都利雅德（Riyadh），同時在葉門（Yemen）與沙烏地阿拉伯支持的政府部隊交戰。 事件經過：BBC World 與 NPR World 報導，沙烏地阿拉伯表示胡塞武裝試圖以彈道飛彈攻擊利雅德，這是首都自衝突升溫以來首次遭針對。利雅德機場燃料庫據報遭擊導致延誤。NYT World 指出，胡塞武裝週日在葉門與沙烏地阿拉伯支持部隊激戰，企圖維持戰爭動能。 重要性：這些事件凸顯伊朗支持民兵與沙烏地阿拉伯之間持續升溫，胡塞武裝正推動在葉門的領土擴張。 來源一致與分歧：所有來源均同意利雅德飛彈襲擊企圖及葉門戰事涉及沙烏地阿拉伯支持部隊。 仍不確定：葉門地面戰役確切結果及飛彈造成的確認損害，除沙烏地阿拉伯宣稱攔截外仍未詳述。

title.en: Friedrich Merz Vows to Stay After State Election Disaster

summary.en: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz called his center-right CDU party's losses in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and Berlin state elections a disaster yet vowed to press ahead with reforms. Exit polls showed the party trailing far-right and far-left rivals while the Alternative for Germany made gains.

body.en: Lede: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz faced major setbacks in two state elections but pledged to remain in office and continue reforms. What happened: Exit polls indicated damaging losses for Merz's center-right CDU in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and Berlin. The party finished behind far-right and far-left opponents. The far-right Alternative for Germany recorded significant gains. Why it matters: The results increase pressure on the chancellor and highlight shifting voter preferences in eastern states. Sources agree/disagree: BBC, NPR and NYT all report Merz describing the outcome as a disaster while affirming he will stay and pursue reforms. Still uncertain: Specific vote percentages and long-term political consequences are not detailed in the provided sources.
body.zh-TW: 導言：德國總理梅爾茨（Friedrich Merz）在兩場州選舉中遭遇重大挫敗，但誓言留任並繼續推動改革。 事件經過：出口民調顯示梅爾茨的中間偏右基民盟在梅克倫堡-西波美拉尼亞與柏林州選舉中損失慘重。該黨落後於極右與極左對手。極右的德國另類選擇黨則取得顯著進展。 重要性：這些結果增加總理所承受的壓力，並凸顯東部各州選民偏好的轉變。 來源一致與分歧：英國廣播公司、美國國家公共廣播電台與紐約時報均報導梅爾茨將結果描述為災難，同時確認他將留任並推動改革。 仍未確定：具體得票百分比與長期政治後果在所提供來源中未詳述。

title.en: Ed Sheeran Breaks Silence on Israel-Gaza at First Show Amid Tour Controversy
title.zh-TW: 艾德·希蘭（Ed Sheeran）巡演爭議後首場演出談以色列加薩議題

summary.en: Ed Sheeran addressed Israel and Gaza at his Philadelphia concert, his first show after Macklemore was dropped from the tour over pro-Palestinian remarks. He admitted mistakes, apologized to fans, and discussed freedom of speech. SNL UK mocked him while Dropkick Murphys' Ken Casey criticized his stance.
summary.zh-TW: 艾德·希蘭（Ed Sheeran）在費城演唱會上談論以色列與加薩議題，這是他自麥可莫爾（Macklemore）因親巴勒斯坦言論被移除巡演後的首場演出。他承認錯誤、向粉絲道歉，並討論言論自由。英國週六夜現場（SNL UK）嘲諷他，而Dropkick Murphys主唱肯·凱西（Ken Casey）則批評其立場。

body.en: Lede: Ed Sheeran spoke about the Israel-Gaza conflict during his first concert since the Macklemore controversy, admitting mistakes and apologizing to fans in Philadelphia. What happened: At the Philadelphia show, Sheeran addressed being placed in the middle of a debate on freedom of speech and the Israel-Gaza issue. He stated he could no longer hide his feelings. The concert ended with him tearing up while thanking fans and apologizing for his political speech. Macklemore had been dropped from the tour after making pro-Palestinian remarks on stage. Why it matters: The remarks highlight tensions around celebrity statements on the conflict and their impact on tours and public perception. Sources agree/disagree: BBC, Rolling Stone, and Just Jared report Sheeran admitting mistakes and apologizing. Billboard notes SNL UK satire on his fence-sitting. Rolling Stone reports Ken Casey saying Sheeran took the knee with Macklemore, which does not sit right with him. Still uncertain: Exact details of Sheeran's full comments on the conflict remain limited to reported snippets.
body.zh-TW: 導言：艾德·希蘭（Ed Sheeran）在費城演唱會上談論以色列加薩衝突，這是他自麥可莫爾（Macklemore）爭議後的首場演出，他承認錯誤並向粉絲道歉。 事件經過：希蘭在費城演出中提到自己被置於言論自由與以色列加薩議題的辯論中間。他表示無法再隱藏感受。演唱會結束時，他坐在舞台上落淚感謝粉絲，並為政治發言道歉。麥可莫爾因在台上發表親巴勒斯坦言論而被移除巡演。 重要性：這些言論凸顯名人對衝突表態所引發的巡演與公眾觀感張力。 來源一致與分歧：英國廣播公司（BBC）、滾石雜誌（Rolling Stone）與Just Jared報導希蘭承認錯誤並道歉。公告牌（Billboard）提及英國週六夜現場（SNL UK）對他騎牆的諷刺。滾石雜誌報導Dropkick Murphys主唱肯·凱西（Ken Casey）指希蘭與麥可莫爾一同表態，這讓他不滿。 仍未確定：希蘭對衝突的完整評論細節僅限於報導片段。

title.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Emerges as Trump's Top Ally in AI Safety Debate
title.zh-TW: 輝達（Nvidia）執行長黃仁勳（Jensen Huang）成為川普在人工智慧安全辯論中的首要盟友

summary.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has gained influence with Trump on key AI topics due to leading the world's most valuable company. In a CBS Sunday Morning interview, he stated a zero percent chance of AI ending the world and called scaring people about AI dangers unnecessary and irresponsible, differing from views held by other AI CEOs.
summary.zh-TW: 輝達（Nvidia）執行長黃仁勳（Jensen Huang）因領導全球最有價值公司而在人工智慧議題上獲得川普青睞。在CBS週日早晨訪談中，他表示人工智慧終結世界的機率為零，並稱散播人工智慧危險恐慌是不必要且不負責任的，這與其他人工智慧執行長的看法不同。

body.en: Lede: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has positioned himself as a key voice in the AI safety debate, earning attention from Trump. What happened: According to CNBC, Huang's role leading the world's most valuable company has given him Trump's ear on important AI topics. The Verge reports that Huang views AI fears as overblown, claiming in a CBS Sunday Morning interview there is a zero percent chance of AI ending the world. He described alarm-raising as unnecessary and irresponsible. Why it matters: Huang's stance contrasts with concerns from other industry leaders and highlights divisions in how AI risks are perceived amid rapid industry growth. Sources agree/disagree: CNBC focuses on Huang's alliance with Trump, while The Verge emphasizes his dismissal of existential risks and references calls from CEOs like Anthropic's Dario Amodei and OpenAI's Sam. Still uncertain: Details on specific policy recommendations or the full extent of Huang's influence remain limited to the provided reports.
body.zh-TW: 導言：輝達（Nvidia）執行長黃仁勳（Jensen Huang）已在人工智慧安全辯論中成為關鍵聲音，獲得川普關注。 事件經過：根據CNBC報導，黃仁勳領導全球最有價值公司，使他在重要人工智慧議題上獲得川普青睞。The Verge報導黃仁勳認為人工智慧恐懼被過度渲染，他在CBS週日早晨訪談中宣稱人工智慧終結世界的機率為零，並形容散播危險警報是不必要且不負責任。 重要性：黃仁勳的立場與其他產業領袖的關切形成對比，凸顯人工智慧風險認知在產業快速成長中的分歧。 來源同意或分歧：CNBC聚焦黃仁勳與川普的結盟，The Verge則強調他對存在風險的否定，並提及Anthropic的Dario Amodei與OpenAI的Sam等執行長的呼籲。 仍不確定：具體政策建議或黃仁勳影響力的完整範圍僅限於所提供報導。

title.en: Moscow Targeted by Hundreds of Drones on Final Day of Russian Elections
title.zh-TW: 莫斯科（Moscow）在俄羅斯選舉最後一天遭數百架無人機襲擊

summary.en: Ukraine launched hundreds of drones at Moscow in what officials described as the largest attack on the Russian capital, with reports of downed drones, damage to an oil refinery and residential building, and two deaths. Sources note additional strikes elsewhere in Russia and mention of a new ballistic missile.
summary.zh-TW: 烏克蘭向莫斯科（Moscow）發射數百架無人機，官員稱這是對俄羅斯首都最大規模攻擊，包含擊落無人機、油廠及住宅受損，以及兩人死亡。來源提及俄羅斯其他地區也遭襲，並提到新型彈道飛彈。

body.en: Lede: Ukraine conducted a major drone assault on Moscow coinciding with the final day of Russian elections. What happened: Multiple reports indicate Ukraine fired hundreds of drones toward Moscow, with Moscow's mayor stating 450 were downed overnight and two people died. Additional accounts describe over 1,000 drones launched at Russia overall, causing damage to a Moscow oil refinery and a residential building. Ukraine also reported using a newly developed ballistic missile in attacks targeting other Russian areas. Why it matters: The scale of the operation marks an escalation in strikes on the Russian capital during a key political period. Sources agree/disagree: All sources confirm a large-scale drone attack on Moscow with Ukrainian involvement. They align on targeting of the capital and broader Russian regions. Still uncertain: Exact totals of drones deployed and specific outcomes like casualties or missile use vary across reports.
body.zh-TW: 導言：烏克蘭在俄羅斯選舉最後一天對莫斯科（Moscow）發動大規模無人機攻擊。 事件經過：多份報導指出烏克蘭向莫斯科（Moscow）發射數百架無人機，莫斯科（Moscow）市長表示夜間擊落450架並有兩人死亡。其他描述提及對俄羅斯總計發射超過1000架無人機，造成莫斯科（Moscow）一處油廠及住宅建築受損。烏克蘭亦表示在攻擊俄羅斯其他地區時使用了新開發的彈道飛彈。 事件重要性：此行動規模顯示在關鍵政治時期對俄羅斯首都的打擊升級。 來源一致與分歧：所有來源均確認烏克蘭對莫斯科（Moscow）進行大規模無人機攻擊，並針對首都及俄羅斯其他地區。 仍未確定：部署無人機確切總數、傷亡細節或飛彈使用等資訊在報導中有所差異。

disagreements.en: Sources conflict on drone numbers (450 downed per one report versus over 1,000 fired overall per another), mention of two deaths, specific damage to an oil refinery and residential building, and use of a newly developed ballistic missile.
disagreements.zh-TW: 來源在無人機數量（一份報導稱擊落450架，另一份稱總計發射超過1000架）、兩人死亡、油廠及住宅受損細節，以及使用新開發彈道飛彈等資訊上存在分歧。

body.en: Lede: Patrick Clancy sat for an emotional 60 Minutes interview where he revealed holding his dying son Callan in his arms. What happened: The interview aired after Lindsay Clancy's triple murder case ended without a verdict. Patrick Clancy discussed life after trauma and said he still talks to his kids all the time. He stated he thinks he did the best he could with the information available. Why it matters: The segment provides Patrick Clancy's perspective on the family tragedy and his remarriage to Rachel Danis, whom he has known since 2024. body.zh-TW: 導言：派崔克·克蘭西（Patrick Clancy）接受《60分鐘》節目情緒訪談，透露抱著兒子卡倫（Callan）離世的最後時刻。 事件經過：訪談於琳賽·克蘭西（Lindsay Clancy）三重謀殺案未決後播出。派崔克·克蘭西（Patrick Clancy）談及創傷後生活，並表示仍經常與孩子們交談。他認為自己在當時資訊下已盡力。 重要性：節目提供派崔克·克蘭西（Patrick Clancy）對家庭悲劇與再婚蕾切爾·丹尼斯（Rachel Danis）的看法，兩人自2024年起相識。 來源一致與分歧：所有報導均確認《60分鐘》訪談、未決結果及派崔克·克蘭西（Patrick Clancy）與蕾切爾·丹尼斯（Rachel Danis）的新婚。 仍未確定：婚姻確切時間表及未來法律發展僅限於訪談報導範圍。
